question: What is Valve's normal work week and usual schedule?
expected_answer: The normal work week is five seven-hour days. Usual hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, including a one-hour unpaid lunch.
evidence: The normal work week for Valve shall consist of five (5), seven (7) hour days. Ordinarily, work hours are from 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, including one hour (unpaid) for lunch.

question: Can employees request a different work schedule?
expected_answer: Yes. Employees may request schedule variation within employer-defined limits to accommodate personal responsibilities. The supervisor determines suitable hours, subject to work assignments and Executive Director approval.
evidence: Employees may request the opportunity to vary their work schedules (within employer-defined limits) to better accommodate personal responsibilities.

question: Who must an employee notify about an absence or planned lateness?
expected_answer: The employee must notify their supervisor and the office manager as far in advance as possible, and no later than one hour before the scheduled workday. In an emergency, notify the supervisor as soon as possible.
evidence: you must notify your supervisor and the office manager as far in advance as possible and no later than one hour before the start of your scheduled work day.

question: What is the overtime rate for non-exempt employees, and who can authorize overtime?
expected_answer: Overtime is paid at one and one-half times the straight-time rate, or twice the regular rate for Sundays or holidays. Only the Executive Director or designee may authorize it, at a supervisor's request.
evidence: Only the Executive Director or his or her designee ... may authorize overtime. Overtime rate is one and one-half time (1½) the employee’s straight time rate, except ... Sunday or holidays when the rate is two times the regular rate.

question: How does the handbook define a full-time employee?
expected_answer: A full-time employee regularly works at least 35 hours per week.
evidence: A Full Time Employee regularly works at least 35 hours per week

question: How often are Valve paychecks distributed?
expected_answer: Paychecks are distributed on the 15th and the last day of each month, or on the preceding workday if either date falls on a weekend or holiday.
evidence: Paychecks are distributed on the 15th and the last day of each month, except when either of those days falls on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, in which case paychecks will be distributed on the preceding workday.

question: How often are formal performance reviews held, and what are they intended to do?
expected_answer: The handbook describes an annual formal review. It gives the supervisor and employee an opportunity to discuss performance, strengthen their working relationship, review the past year, and anticipate needs and objectives for the coming year.
evidence: The annual performance review is a formal opportunity for the supervisor and employee to exchange ideas ... review the past year, and anticipate Valve’s needs in the coming year.

question: When does Valve begin paying individual health insurance premiums for eligible employees?
expected_answer: The handbook says eligible full-time and part-time employees receive individual health and dental insurance beginning after their first full month of employment. Valve presently pays the individual premium, subject to the plan terms.
evidence: individual health and dental insurance benefits ... beginning after the first full month of employment. Valve presently pays the individual insurance premium for all eligible employees.

question: When does Valve contribute to an eligible employee's retirement plan?
expected_answer: For eligible full-time and part-time employees age 21 or older, Valve contributes after the employee becomes vested after one year of employment. Employees may contribute from the start of employment.
evidence: Valve contributes to the employee’s retirement plan when employee becomes vested after one year of employment. Eligible employees may contribute to retirement plan at start of employment.

question: How many holidays are full-time employees eligible for each year?
expected_answer: Full-time employees are eligible for 11.5 holidays per year.
evidence: Full-Time Employees are eligible for 11.5 holidays per year

question: How much vacation does a full-time employee earn during the first year?
expected_answer: Full-time employees do not earn vacation during their first 90 days. During the remaining nine months of the first year, they earn two weeks, or 10 days, of paid vacation.
evidence: During the first 90 days of employment full- and part-time employees will not earn Vacation benefits. During the remaining nine months of first year employment, a full-time employee will earn two weeks (10 days) of paid Vacation.

question: How does full-time vacation accrual change with length of service?
expected_answer: After the first year, a full-time employee earns 10 days in the second year, 15 days in the third year, and 20 days per year in the fourth year and thereafter.
evidence: two weeks (10 days) ... during the second year ... third year ... three weeks (15 days) ... fourth year and thereafter ... four weeks (20 days)

question: How much sick leave does a full-time employee accrue?
expected_answer: A full-time employee accrues seven hours, or one day, of sick leave per month starting on the first day of employment. Accrual can accumulate up to 30 days or 210 hours.
evidence: one day (7 hours) per month for full-time employees beginning at first day of employment ... up to a maximum of 30 days (210 hours)

question: How many personal leave days are provided, and when can employees use them?
expected_answer: Eligible full-time and part-time employees receive three personal leave days per calendar year after completing six months of employment. The leave cannot be used in the first six months or carried into the next year, and requires prior approval.
evidence: Valve provides three (3) days of personal leave per calendar year to all Full-Time and Part-Time employees who have completed six months of employment.

question: How much paid bereavement leave does the handbook provide for an immediate family member?
expected_answer: Five paid days for the death of a spouse or life partner, child, or parent. The handbook provides three days for certain other listed relatives.
evidence: five (5) days ... (spouse/life partner, child or parent) and three (3) days for grandparent, sister or brother, father-in-law, mother-in-law, or grandchildren.

question: How much unpaid parental leave may an employee take for a child's school-related events?
expected_answer: A parent may take up to 24 hours of unpaid leave during any 12-month period for school-related events involving their child. Accrued vacation or personal leave may be used instead.
evidence: A parent is entitled to a total of 24 hours of unpaid leave during any 12-month period to attend or participate in school-related events for his or her child.

question: What is Valve's policy for severe weather closures?
expected_answer: Valve closes when federal government offices in the Washington metropolitan area close because of severe weather. It also follows a liberal leave policy when the federal government announces one.
evidence: Valve closes when federal government offices in the Washington metropolitan area are closed due to severe weather conditions. Valve also will follow a liberal leave policy when the federal government announces that liberal leave is applicable.

question: How long may an employee who has worked at least one year request an extended personal leave?
expected_answer: They may apply for an unpaid personal leave of up to eight weeks. Approval is discretionary, and the handbook lists several factors Valve may consider.
evidence: Employees who have been employed by Valve for at least one year may apply for personal leaves of absence for up to eight weeks. Personal leaves are unpaid and are discretionary with the management of Valve.

question: What expenses may be reimbursed when employees use their personal cars for Valve business?
expected_answer: Authorized use of a personal car for Valve business is reimbursed at the U.S. Internal Revenue Service approved rate.
evidence: Employees authorized to use their personal cars for Valve business are reimbursed at the U.S. Internal Revenue Service approved rate.

question: How much written notice does Valve encourage before an employee resigns?
expected_answer: Valve encourages at least 10 business days of written notice; it says a longer period is desired and the intention should be made known as far in advance as possible.
evidence: Employees are encouraged to give at least 10 business days of written notice. Since a longer period is desired, the intention to resign should be made known as far in advance as possible.

question: What happens to accrued unused vacation when an employee resigns or is laid off?
expected_answer: Employees who resign or are terminated or laid off are entitled to receive accrued, unused vacation benefits.
evidence: Employees who resign are entitled to receive accrued, unused Vacation benefits. ... Employees who are terminated or laid off are entitled to receive accrued, unused Vacation benefits.

question: Who has authority to discharge an employee?
expected_answer: The Executive Director has authority to discharge an employee.
evidence: The Executive Director has authority to discharge an employee from the employ of Valve.

question: What should an employee do if they need to report workplace harassment?
expected_answer: They should report it immediately to their supervisor or the Executive Director. Possible harassment by customers, vendors, or others in a business relationship should also be reported as soon as possible.
evidence: you should report the incident immediately to your supervisor or to the Executive Director.

question: Does the handbook identify the current health insurance provider by name?
expected_answer: No. It says information about Valve's health plans will be provided at employment, but it does not name an insurance provider.
evidence: Information about Valve’s health plan(s) will be provided to the employee at the time of employment.

question: How many paid vacation days does a temporary employee receive each year?
expected_answer: No answer found. The handbook says temporary employees are ineligible for vacation benefits.
evidence: Temporary employees are ineligible for Vacation benefits.

question: What should employees do after an on-the-job accident, even if no injury is apparent?
expected_answer: They must report the accident. The handbook says every on-the-job accident must be reported even if there are no apparent injuries.
evidence: any accident that occurs on the job must be reported, even if there are no injuries apparent at the time.

question: How many consecutive days of absence without notifying a supervisor may be treated as voluntary termination?
expected_answer: Three consecutive days. The handbook says an employee absent for three consecutive days without notifying their supervisor or the Executive Director will be considered to have voluntarily terminated employment.
evidence: absent from work for three consecutive days without notification to his or her supervisor or the Executive Director will be considered to have voluntarily terminated his or her employment.

question: What is the maximum sick leave accrual for a full-time employee?
expected_answer: 30 days, or 210 hours. The handbook says the limit is prorated for part-time employees.
evidence: up to a maximum of 30 days (210 hours) for full-time employees.

question: Are unused sick leave benefits paid out when employment ends?
expected_answer: No. The handbook says no sick leave benefits are paid upon separation for any reason.
evidence: No sick leave benefits are paid upon separation of employment from Valve for any reason.

question: What does the handbook say about personal use of Valve's computer systems?
expected_answer: Limited personal use is allowed, but it must not conflict with the systems' primary purpose, Valve's ethical responsibilities, or applicable laws and regulations.
evidence: Although limited personal use of Valve’s systems is allowed ... no use of these systems should ever conflict with the primary purpose for which they have been provided, Valve’s ethical responsibilities or with applicable laws and regulations.

question: May employees expect privacy for data stored in Valve's computer systems?
expected_answer: No. The handbook says Valve may inspect and monitor system data at any time and employees should have no expectation of privacy, including for items marked private.
evidence: Valve may inspect and monitor such data at any time. No individual should have any expectation of privacy for messages or other data recorded in Valve’s systems.

question: When is employee internet access provided under the handbook?
expected_answer: Internet access is provided when there is a necessity and the access has been specifically approved.
evidence: At this time, desktop access to the Internet is provided to employees when there is a necessity and the access has been specifically approved.
